GBX.NET.CLI (.NET tool)

Usage: gbx [command] <file> [options]

Commands:
  parse <file>                  Inspect a Gbx or PAK file (default).
  eval <file> [code...]         Evaluate C# against a Gbx or PAK file.
  script <file> [-- args...]    Run a C# script with GBX.NET available.
  verify <file>                 Fully parse a Gbx file or a folder tree of Gbx files.
  pak files <file>              List PAK or ZIP files, resolving known hashes.
  pak verify <file>             Fully parse Gbx entries of archives and list failures.
  pak extract <file>            Extract all or matching PAK or ZIP entries.
  compress <file>               Compress a Gbx body.
  decompress <file>             Decompress a Gbx body.

Global options:
  -h, --help                   Show help for the current command.
  -v, --version                Show the CLI version.

Run gbx <command> --help for command options and examples.

Usage: gbx script <file> [-- args...]

Run a C# script file with GBX.NET references, async support, and Args.
Use Print(value), Output, or Console.WriteLine for output. Relative #load paths use the script directory.

Command options:
  --                           Pass remaining arguments to the script, including --help and --version.

Global options:
  -h, --help                   Show help for the current command.
  -v, --version                Show the CLI version.

Example:
  gbx script inspect.csx -- "My Map.Map.Gbx"

GBX.NET.CLI (.NET tool)

Usage: gbx verify <file> [options]

Fully parse a Gbx file and report the exception if it fails. Exit with code 1 if any fail.
Pass a folder to verify every Gbx file in it and its subfolders. Other files are skipped.

Command options:
  -g, --game <version>         Select the game when class IDs are reused, for example TMSX.

Global options:
  -h, --help                   Show help for the current command.
  -v, --version                Show the CLI version.

Example:
  gbx verify "Maps"

GBX.NET.CLI (.NET tool)

Usage: gbx pak files <file> [options]

List every matching PAK or ZIP entry, resolving known hashes and keeping unresolved hashes.
Append a path or pattern to the archive to select entries. Matching ignores case.

Command options:
  --resolved                   Show named files and hashes with known names.
  --unresolved                 Show only hashes without known names.

The filters cannot be combined. Without a filter, all matching entries are listed.

Global options:
  -h, --help                   Show help for the current command.
  -v, --version                Show the CLI version.

Example:
  gbx pak files "Resource.pak/Media/Texture/*" --unresolved

GBX.NET.CLI (.NET tool)

Usage: gbx pak extract <file> [options]

Extract every matching entry, restoring known filenames and preserving folders.
Append a path or pattern to the archive to select entries. Matching ignores case.

Command options:
  -o, --output <directory>     Destination (default: <archive>.extracted). Never overwrite existing files.

Global options:
  -h, --help                   Show help for the current command.
  -v, --version                Show the CLI version.

Example:
  gbx pak extract "Resource.pak/Media/Texture/*.gbx" -o "Textures"
